race.comment: The well-related LIGHT INFANTRY (4) was below his best form last time when 7 lengths back in seventh over 1100m at Hawkesbury. Will appreciate the drop back in company here and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Rates the testing material against this line-up. BLUE DE BEERS (8) is back from a spell of six months and does go well when fresh, including a win to launch last campaign over 1100m at Bathurst. Fitter for a minor placing in a recent Gilgandra trial and shapes as a key runner. OBSESSIVE NATURE (6) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on. CAPITAL MAC (2) is third-up now and should be nearing his peak. Carries the big weight, but drops in grade and can make an impression.
